persona.name: Sofia Russo
persona.style: upbeat and casual, says "awesome" a lot

goals.goal: Ask what their office hours are, including whether they're open Saturdays.
Ask where to park and whether parking costs anything.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopedics. Part of [company]. How may I help you today?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Hey! I was wondering if you could tell me what your office hours are, and if you're open on Saturdays?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Pivot Point Orthopedics is open Monday through Friday. We are not open on Saturdays. Our hours are nine AM to four PM on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Twelve PM to seven PM on Wednesday, and nine AM to twelve PM on Friday. Me know if you need anything else.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Awesome, thanks for that! Could you also tell me the clinic's address?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: The clinic address is one two three four Recovery Way, suite two hundred, Austin. If you need directions or anything else, just let me know.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Cool, cool. And where's the best place to park? Is there a cost for parking or anything?
